data.name: Lavesh
data.gender_notes: Lavesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit 'Lav', meaning 'to play' and 'esh', meaning 'god'. This name signifies the god of love and passion. In Hindu mythology, Lavesh is a form of the god Krishna, known for his romantic exploits. The name Lavesh carries the meaning “God of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lavesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lavesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
